note: USACE campground on the James River arm of Table Rock Lake at Cape Fair. On the east loop, sites 8-10, 12 and 13 sit on the open bank of the cove, 15-25 m from the water with no road between; the swim beach and its parking strip are just south of them. The west loop (38-47) sits above the marina behind its own road. --Claude
summary: Confirmed from rec.gov: 46 electric sites (stored 45 = description), 50-amp at 37 / 30-amp at 9, water at all, no sewer listed; every site on the $25 STANDARD ELECTRIC template, so fees $16-25 -> $25-25; season Apr 1 - Oct 30 written; 3-night holiday minimum, 14 nights. Lakefront kept on sites 8-10, 12, 13 (pads 15-25 m from the cove, open bank, no road). Phone 417-538-2220 to add; pin is the rec.gov facility point ~350 m NW of the sites - move.
flags: WATERFRONT (stored lakefront, kept). Measured on the 0.22 m/px leaf-off frame: east-loop sites 8, 9 and 10 have pads on the bank ~15-18 m from the water's edge, with a grassy/rocky bank and scattered trees and no road between (the loop road runs behind the pads). Site 12 is ~26 m away, and site 13 ~20 m across open grass to the riprap. The swim beach (buoyed swim area, sand) and the paved beach parking strip by sites 15-17 are day use and earn nothing; sites 14-17 sit behind that strip. West-loop sites 38-42 have their own loop/lot road and a wooded bank between them and the marina cove, so they aren't on-water. So the value rests on 8-10, 12 and 13.

PIN: stored 36.7225,-93.5317 = the rec.gov facility point. It lies in the woods by the entrance road ~150 m NW of the west loop and ~350 m from the site centroid (36.72122,-93.52813). Suggest moving onto the east loop at 36.7212,-93.5281.
PHONE: rec.gov lists 417-538-2220; the entry has no phone. apply.py doesn't write it, so add it by hand.
FEES: stored low $16 was the rate table's nonelectric type, which no current site uses; every site's fee template is STANDARD ELECTRIC $25.
SITE COUNT: description says 45 reservable campsites; the catalog has 46 overnight sites (01-47, no 45), so 46 written.
